description: Example model cost tiers for agent-doctor. Copy to $ZOUROBOROS_CONFIG_DIR/agent-doctor/model-tiers.json and replace the placeholder ids with the model ids your Hermes profile and cron jobs use. Jobs on models not listed here are reported under model-catalog and never auto-downgraded.

downgradeDefaults._note: Targets for `doctor.ts apply`. A value is a model id or {"model": id, "provider": name}. Empty values disable the automatic model change.

script_executor.description: Runs bash/bun commands and reports output

status_reporter.description: Reads files/state and composes a status message

content_generator.description: Generates creative content, social posts, or marketing copy

analyst.description: Performs analysis, synthesis, or security assessment
